title: Heavily Armed Cops Storm Stolen Yacht Headed to Bahamas
description:
Bodycams and helicopter cameras caught a thrilling chase involving a Russian National who allegedly stole a 68-foot luxury yacht from a marina in Jupiter, Florida. Heavily armed deputies stormed the boat and surrounded the suspect, Nikolai Vilkov, who police believe was headed to the Bahamas for a "smuggling venture." Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
